# EWD support

Use **Bug / reproducibility problem** for build, script, manifest or reproduction failures.

Use **Scientific / model issue** for World3 structure, empirical calibration, source provenance, parameter identification, validation, sensitivity or candidate-extension questions.

Before opening an issue, check [README.md](../README.md) and [STATUS.md](../STATUS.md).

Do not include sensitive vulnerability details in a public issue. A dedicated security policy is deferred until a private reporting route is configured.
